explanation: Copy the successor's payload into the target and link the target directly to the successor's successor.
correctness: Every path before the target is unchanged. Replacing the target value and bypassing its successor removes exactly the target position from the value sequence while preserving the required target identity.
walkthrough: The list is 9 -> 4 -> 7 -> 2 and the supplied target is the node currently holding 4. Copy 7 into that same target object and point it to the node holding 2. The head-to-tail values become [9,7,2]. An alias to the target now observes 7, while an alias to the bypassed successor still refers to its separate, unchanged object. The callable receives only the target node and returns void/None/undefined. JSON supplies [listValues,targetIndex]; expected is the reachable value sequence after mutation, with identity checked separately.
edgeCases: Deleting the head of [3,6] leaves that same head object holding 6 with Next=null. A tail target is outside the valid bank domain.
timeComplexity: O(1) time: read the successor and replace exactly the target’s Value and Next fields.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space: retain at most one successor reference; allocate no list nodes.
